reviews.title: Watch ads with a smidge of TV on the side.$$$$
reviews.text: I’m not sure how this has 4.6 stars. Were people paid? It’s ridiculously expensive if you really want to watch anything. If you’re at a point in a series where you can still open the next episode by watching an ad, it’s oppressive, because it takes longer to watch the ads than the episode. Each ad is at least about 120 seconds if not longer, then the episode is like 20, maybe 30 seconds if you’re really lucky. The app is really more ads, with a touch of show on the side. Don’t bother. This is undoubtedly the worst app I’ve come across for these supposed TV Shorts. This doesn’t even tell you how many coins you need to open the next episode on something, just how much money you need to spend to watch the whole thing. The “SHORT” I was trying to watch wanted $37 after I got done with ads to purchase the whole show. I can purchase the brand new full length 4K UHD, Blu Ray, and digital copy (in one set) of the new Wicked movie for only $2.95 more than that and it’s a professionally done project with famous actors and singers and based on a famous, hit Broadway show. The absurdity of the prices on this app are astounding. The sheer audacity in charging so much money is absurd. These shows are mildly interesting but only mildly, certainly not worth so much of a person’s hard earned money. The acting and the scripts are okay but not worth this kind of money they’re demanding!$$$$$$
